practical experience: Internships give college students practical experience that they cannot get from books or lectures alone.
實習讓大學生獲得光靠書本或課堂學不到的實務經驗。
a practical joke: As a practical joke, my brother put salt in the sugar bowl, and Dad's coffee tasted terrible.
我弟弟把鹽放進糖罐裡惡作劇，結果爸爸的咖啡難喝極了。
for all practical purposes: The old phone still turns on, but for all practical purposes it is useless because nothing works.
那支舊手機還能開機，但實際上它已經沒用了，因為什麼功能都不能用。
practical skills: This course teaches practical skills like cooking and fixing a bike, not just theory from textbooks.
這門課教的是煮飯和修腳踏車這類實用技能，而不只是課本上的理論。
a practical person: My mom is a practical person, so she buys shoes that are comfortable rather than ones that look fashionable.
我媽媽是個務實的人，所以她買的是好穿的鞋，而不是看起來時髦的鞋。
practical considerations: We loved the big house, but practical considerations such as cost and distance from school made us choose another.
我們很喜歡那間大房子，但費用和離學校的距離等實際的考量讓我們選了另一間。
precious time: Don't waste your precious time playing phone games; the entrance exam is only two weeks away.
別把寶貴的時間浪費在玩手機遊戲上，大學入學考試只剩兩週了。
precious metals: Gold and silver are precious metals that people have used to make coins and jewelry for centuries.
金和銀是貴金屬，幾百年來人們一直用它們製作錢幣和珠寶。
a precious few: Many people applied for the scholarship, but only a precious few were chosen to study abroad.
很多人申請了這筆獎學金，但只有少之又少的人被選上出國留學。
precious memories: These old photos hold precious memories of my grandmother, so I would never sell them for any price.
這些老照片承載著我對祖母珍貴的回憶，所以不管出多少錢我都不會賣。
a precious stone: A diamond is a precious stone, so a ring with a large one can cost a fortune.
鑽石是一種寶石，所以一枚鑲著大鑽石的戒指可能要價不菲。
Don't be so precious!: "Don't be so precious! It's just a little mud on your shoes," Dad said as we kept hiking.
「別那麼矯情！只是鞋子上沾了一點泥巴而已。」爸爸一邊說，我們一邊繼續健行。
at that precise moment: I was just about to call Lisa, and at that precise moment my phone rang with her name on it.
我正準備打電話給麗莎，就在那一刻，我的手機響了，螢幕上正是她的名字。
to be precise: I've lived in Taipei for a long time—to be precise, eleven years and three months.
我在台北住了很久——準確地說，是十一年又三個月。
precise instructions: The chemistry teacher gave us precise instructions on how much of each liquid to mix, to avoid any danger.
化學老師給了我們每種液體該混合多少的精確指示，以避免任何危險。
the precise details: The police asked the witness to recall the precise details of the accident, such as the exact time and car color.
警方請目擊者回想這起車禍的確切細節，例如準確的時間和車子的顏色。
precise measurements: Baking a cake requires precise measurements, because even a few extra grams of sugar can ruin it.
烤蛋糕需要精確的測量，因為就算多了幾公克的糖也可能毀了它。
a pregnant pause: After he asked her to marry him, there was a pregnant pause, and everyone held their breath waiting for her answer.
他向她求婚後，出現了一陣意味深長的停頓，大家都屏住呼吸等她回答。
a pregnant silence: When the teacher asked who had broken the window, a pregnant silence filled the room as students looked at Tom.
老師問是誰打破窗戶時，教室裡瀰漫著意味深長的沉默，同學們都看向湯姆。
be pregnant with meaning: Every line of the old poem is pregnant with meaning, so we read it slowly to understand its deeper ideas.
這首古詩的每一句都充滿深意，所以我們慢慢讀，好理解其中更深的思想。
six months pregnant: My aunt is six months pregnant, so she is preparing clothes and toys for the baby arriving this spring.
我阿姨懷孕六個月了，所以她正在為今年春天要出生的寶寶準備衣服和玩具。
a preliminary investigation: A preliminary investigation suggests the fire was caused by bad wiring, but a full report will come later.
初步調查顯示火災是電線老舊所引起，但完整報告會晚一點才出爐。
preliminary results: The preliminary results of the study look promising, but scientists need more tests before they can be sure.
這項研究的初步結果看起來很有希望，但科學家還需要更多測試才能確定。
the preliminary round: Only the top eight swimmers in the preliminary round will move on to compete in the final.
只有預賽中前八名的泳將能晉級參加決賽。
preliminary talks: The two companies held preliminary talks last week before beginning serious negotiations on the deal.
兩家公司上週舉行了預備會談，之後才會針對這筆交易展開正式談判。
preliminary to: Careful research is preliminary to writing a good report, so you must gather the facts first.
仔細的研究是在撰寫好報告之前的步驟，所以你必須先蒐集事實。
a premature baby: She was a premature baby, born eight weeks early, so she stayed in the hospital for a month.
她是個早產兒，提早八週出生，所以在醫院待了一個月。
a premature death: The famous singer's premature death at the age of thirty-five shocked fans all over the world.
這位知名歌手三十五歲就早逝，震驚了全世界的歌迷。
premature conclusions: Don't jump to premature conclusions before you have heard both sides of the story.
在你聽完雙方說法之前，不要妄下過早的結論。
It is premature to say…: It is premature to say whether the new medicine works, since the tests are still at an early stage.
現在說這種新藥是否有效還太早，因為試驗仍處於初期階段。
premature aging: Too much time in the sun can cause premature aging of the skin, such as wrinkles in your thirties.
曬太多太陽會導致皮膚早衰，例如三十幾歲就長皺紋。
